concepts.label: anosognosia

concepts.label: tactile agnosia

concepts.label: breast sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the breast. Representative examples include angiosarcoma, liposarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and extraskeletal osteosarcoma.

concepts.label: prostatic acinar adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An invasive adenocarcinoma of the prostate gland composed of secretory cells. It is the most common histologic type of prostate adenocarcinoma. Several morphologic variants exist, including atrophic, pseudohyperplastic, foamy gland, and oncocytic variants.

concepts.label: substance-related disorder
concepts.description: A category of psychiatric disorders which include disorders related to the taking of a drug of abuse (including alcohol, prescribed medications and recreational drugs).

concepts.label: brain glioblastoma
concepts.description: A WHO grade IV malignant astrocytic tumor that arises from the brain, usually the cerebral hemispheres. It is characterized by the presence of poorly differentiated astrocytes, cellular polymorphism, nuclear atypia, and increased mitotic activity. The prognosis is poor.
synonyms: grade IV astrocytic tumour of brain

concepts.label: adult astrocytic tumor
concepts.description: An astrocytic tumor occurring during adulthood. Representative examples include diffuse astrocytoma, anaplastic astrocytoma, and glioblastoma.

concepts.label: childhood astrocytic tumor
concepts.description: An astrocytic tumor appearing before the age of twenty one without designation of benign or malignant nor designated location.

concepts.label: gingival overgrowth
concepts.description: Excessive growth of the gingiva either by an increase in the size of the constituent cells (gingival hypertrophy) or by an increase in their number (gingival hyperplasia). (From Jablonski's Dictionary of Dentistry, 1992, p574)

concepts.label: papillary adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of adenocarcinoma. It is characterized by the presence of a papillary growth pattern. Representative examples include thyroid gland papillary carcinoma, invasive papillary breast carcinoma, and ovarian serous surface papillary adenocarcinoma.

concepts.label: kidney benign neoplasm
concepts.description: A non-metastasizing neoplasm that arises from the kidney. Representative examples include cystic nephroma, metanephric adenoma, oncocytoma, and urothelial papilloma of the renal pelvis.

concepts.label: hepatobiliary neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the liver parenchyma, bile ducts, and gallbladder. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include hepatocellular adenoma, bile duct adenoma, and gallbladder lipoma. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include hepatocellular carcinoma, in...

concepts.label: hepatobiliary disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the liver, bile ducts, and gallbladder. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include hepatitis, cirrhosis, cholangitis, and cholecystitis. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include hepatocellular adenoma, hepatocell...
synonyms: disease or disorder of hepatobiliary system

concepts.label: digestive system cancer
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving any part of the digestive system.

concepts.label: gallbladder papillary neoplasm
concepts.description: A non-invasive, papillary epithelial neoplasm that arises from the epithelium of the gallbladder. Intraepithelial neoplasia is present.

concepts.label: anus disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the anal canal or anal margin. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include hemorrhoids and anal ulcer. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include carcinoma, lymphoma, and melanoma.

concepts.label: hepatic porphyria
concepts.description: A group of metabolic diseases due to deficiency of one of a number of liver enzymes in the biosynthetic pathway of heme. They are characterized by the accumulation and increased excretion of porphyrins or its precursors. Clinical features include neurological symptoms (porphyria, acute intermitte...

concepts.label: tenosynovial giant cell tumor
concepts.description: A tumor usually arising in the synovium of joints, bursa or tendon sheath. It is characterized by the presence of mononuclear cells, multinucleated osteoclast-like giant cells, hemosiderin-laden macrophages, foam cells, and an inflammatory infiltrate. According to the growth pattern, it is classi...
synonyms: giant cell neoplasm of tendon sheath
giant cell neoplasm of the Tenosynovium
giant cell tumor of tendon sheath
giant cell tumor of the Tenosynovium
giant cell tumour of the Tenosynovium

concepts.description: The mucinoses are a diverse group of disorders which have in common the deposition of basophilic, finely granular and stringy material (mucin) in the connective tissues of the dermis (dermal mucinoses), in the pilosebaceous follicles (follicular mucinoses), or in the epidermis and tumors derived ...

concepts.label: inherited lipid metabolism disorder
concepts.description: An inherited metabolic disorder caused by an enzyme deficiency, resulting in an inability to oxidize fatty acids for energy production.

concepts.label: dermal unilateral segmental cavernous angioma
concepts.description: Class

concepts.label: keratoacanthoma
concepts.description: A dome-shaped, rapidly growing skin lesion composed of well differentiated squamous cells. It represents a proliferation of the infundibular epithelium of the hair follicle and its morphologic distinction from a well differentiated carcinoma may be difficult or impossible. Keratoacanthomas affect...

concepts.label: synovium neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant soft tissue neoplasm arising exclusively from the synovial membrane. Examples include the diffuse giant cell tumor of tendon sheath, localized giant cell tumor of tendon sheath, and malignant giant cell tumor of tendon sheath.
synonyms: neoplasm of synovial membrane of synovial joint
synovial membrane of synovial joint neoplasm
synovial membrane of synovial joint neoplasm (disease)
synovial membrane of synovial joint tumor
synovial membrane of synovial joint tumour
tumor of synovial membrane of synovial joint
tumour of synovial membrane of synovial joint

concepts.label: skin squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma arising from the squamous cells of the epidermis. Skin squamous cell carcinoma is most commonly found on sun-exposed areas. The majority of the tumors are well-differentiated.
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of the skin
zone of skin squamous cell carcinoma

concepts.label: skin neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant tumor involving the skin. Representative examples of benign skin neoplasms include the benign melanocytic skin nevus, acanthoma, sebaceous adenoma, sweat gland adenoma, lipoma, hemangioma, fibroma, and benign fibrous histiocytoma. Representative examples of malignant skin ne...

concepts.label: squamous cell neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm that is composed of squamous epithelial cells. Squamous cell carcinoma is a representative example.

concepts.label: fallopian tube papilloma
concepts.description: A benign epithelial neoplasm that arises from the fallopian tube. It is characterized by the presence of fibrovascular stalks lined by serous epithelial cells.

concepts.label: inverted papilloma
concepts.description: An endophytic benign papillary epithelial neoplasm that results from the invagination and proliferation of epithelial cells in the underlying stroma. Representative examples are the inverted urothelial papilloma that arises from the urinary tract and inverted Schneiderian papilloma that arises fr...

concepts.label: childhood oligodendroglioma
concepts.description: An oligodendroglioma that arises from the central nervous system and occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: spinal cord oligodendroglioma
concepts.description: A oligodendroglioma that involves the spinal cord.
synonyms: well differentiated spinal cord oligodendroglial tumor
well differentiated spinal cord oligodendroglial tumour

concepts.label: spinal cord glioma
concepts.description: A neoplasm that arises from glial cells in the spinal cord. Representative examples include astrocytoma, oligodendroglioma, and ependymoma.

concepts.label: adult oligodendroglioma
concepts.description: An oligodendroglioma occurring during adulthood.

concepts.label: brain oligodendroglioma
concepts.description: A oligodendroglioma that involves the brain.

concepts.label: spinal cord disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the spinal cord.
synonyms: disease or disorder of spinal cord

concepts.label: schwannoma
concepts.description: A benign, usually encapsulated slow growing tumor composed of Schwann cells. It affects peripheral and cranial nerves. It recurs infrequently and only rare cases associated with malignant transformation have been reported.

concepts.label: nerve sheath neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from the perineural cells in the sheaths surrounding the nerves. Representative examples include neurofibroma, schwannoma, and malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.

concepts.label: cellular schwannoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of schwannoma characterized by hypercellularity, Antoni A pattern, and the absence of well-formed Verocay bodies.

concepts.label: schwannoma of twelfth cranial nerve
concepts.description: A schwannoma that involves the hypoglossal nerve.
synonyms: neurilemmoma of the twelfth cranial nerve
schwannoma of the twelfth cranial nerve

concepts.label: hypoglossal nerve neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm involving a hypoglossal nerve.
synonyms: neoplasm of the twelfth cranial nerve
tumor of the twelfth cranial nerve
tumour of the twelfth cranial nerve

concepts.label: cerebellopontine angle tumor
concepts.description: A neoplasm that affects the cerebellopontine angle. Representative examples include vestibular schwannoma and meningioma.
synonyms: neoplasm of the cerebellar Pontine angle
tumor of the cerebellar Pontine angle
tumour of the cerebellar Pontine angle

concepts.label: sympathetic neurilemmoma
concepts.description: A benign tumor derived from schwann cells of the peripheral sympathetic nervous system, including the sympathetic plexus.

concepts.label: trigeminal schwannoma
concepts.description: A schwannoma that involves the trigeminal nerve.
synonyms: neurilemmoma of the fifth cranial nerve
schwannoma of the fifth cranial nerve

concepts.label: microcystic/reticular schwannoma
concepts.description: The rarest histopathologic subtype of Schwannoma. The reported cases have been located in the gastrointestinal submucosa or subcutaneous tissue. Morphologically it is characterized by the presence of a microcyst-rich network of spindle cells with minimal amount of cytoplasm and Antoni A tissue.

concepts.label: melanotic neurilemmoma
concepts.description: A rare circumscribed, non-encapsulated and grossly pigmented nerve sheath tumor. It is composed of cells with the immunophenotypic and electron microscopic features of Schwann cells which contain melanosomes and are positive for melanoma markers. It usually involves spinal nerve roots but may occ...

concepts.label: plexiform schwannoma
concepts.description: A schwannoma characterized by a plexiform or multinodular growth pattern. It usually arises from the skin or subcutaneous tissues in the extremities, trunk, and head and neck.

concepts.label: lysosomal storage disease
concepts.description: A metabolic disorder caused by mutations in proteins critical for lysosomal function, including lysosomal enzymes, lysosomal integral membrane proteins, and proteins involved in the post-translational modification and trafficking of lysosomal proteins.

concepts.label: demyelinating disease
concepts.description: A broad group of disorders that affect the myelin sheaths that cover the neurons. Myelin sheathes cover neuronal axons in the central and peripheral nervous system and function to increase traveling impulse speeds. Disruption of this sheath impairs neuronal transmission and can result in disorder...

concepts.label: jejunal somatostatinoma
concepts.description: A somatostatin-producing neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the jejunum. It is characterized by the presence of tubulo-glandular structures.
synonyms: Delta cell tumor of the jejunum
Delta cell tumour of the jejunum
jejunal delta cell somatostatin producing tumour

concepts.label: jejunal neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the wall of the jejunum. Representative examples include adenoma, carcinoma, and lymphoma.

concepts.label: myelitis
concepts.description: An inflammatory process affecting the spinal cord. Causes include viral infections, autoimmune disorders, vascular disorders, and toxic agents. Symptoms include weakness, paresthesia, sensory loss, pain, and incontinence.

concepts.label: tracheal disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the trachea. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include congenital malformations and infection. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include carcinoma and lymphoma.

concepts.label: primary central nervous system lymphoma
concepts.description: A non-Hodgkin or Hodgkin lymphoma that arises in the brain or spinal cord as a primary lesion. There is no evidence of lymphoma outside the central nervous system at the time of diagnosis.

concepts.label: prostate embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm of the prostate. It is characterized by the presence of skeletal muscle exhibiting embryonic features.

concepts.label: embryonal extrahepatic bile duct rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts.
synonyms: embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma (disease) of extrahepatic bile duct
embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma of extrahepatic bile duct
embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

concepts.label: extrahepatic bile duct rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation, arising from the extrahepatic bile ducts.
synonyms: rhabdomyosarcoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

concepts.label: botryoid rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma arising from organs with a mucosal epithelial surface. It is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules within an abundant myxoid stroma.

concepts.label: orbit embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the orbit. It is characterized by the presence of skeletal muscle tissue exhibiting embryonic features.

concepts.label: orbit rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm with skeletal muscle differentiation that arises from the orbit.

concepts.label: spindle cell rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An uncommon variant of rhabdomyosarcoma characterized by the presence of whorls of spindle cells forming a storiform pattern. In children it usually arises in the paratesticular region. In adults it usually arises from the deep soft tissues in the head and neck.

concepts.label: subacute leukemia
concepts.description: A leukemia that is in between acute and chronic leukemia and is characterized by a moderate duration or severity.

concepts.label: thymus cancer
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the thymus. This category includes malignant thymomas, thymic lymphomas, primary thymic carcinomas, and metastatic carcinomas from other anatomic sites.

concepts.label: encapsulated thymoma
concepts.description: A thymoma that is confined within the capsule and may display benign or malignant morphologic characteristics.

concepts.label: thymoma type A
concepts.description: A thymic epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of spindle and/or oval neoplastic epithelial cells. Lymphocytic infiltration is minimal or absent. It may be associated with myasthenia gravis or pure red cell aplasia. The majority of cases occur in the anterior mediastinum as Masaoka st...
synonyms: primary thymic epithelial neoplasm type A
primary thymic epithelial tumor type A
primary thymic epithelial tumour type A

concepts.label: combined thymoma
concepts.description: Class

concepts.label: invasive malignant thymoma
concepts.description: A malignant thymoma that extends beyond the capsule and infiltrates the surrounding tissues.

concepts.label: notochordal tumor
concepts.description: A bone tumor arising from the remnants of the fetal notochord. This category includes the chordoma and benign notochordal cell tumor.

concepts.label: germinoma
concepts.description: A malignant germ cell tumor arising in the central nervous system. It is characterized by the presence of primitive, large malignant germ cells and lymphocytes.

concepts.label: teratocarcinoma
concepts.description: A germ cell tumor characterized by the presence of an embryonal carcinoma component and a teratoma component.

concepts.label: teratoma
concepts.description: A non-seminomatous germ cell tumor characterized by the presence of various tissues which correspond to the different germinal layers (endoderm, mesoderm, and ectoderm). It occurs in the testis, ovary, and extragonadal sites including central nervous system, mediastinum, lung, and stomach. Accord...

concepts.label: central nervous system disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the central nervous system.
synonyms: central nervous system disease or disorder
disease of the central nervous system
disease or disorder of central nervous system

concepts.label: angiomyolipoma
concepts.description: A neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation often associated with tuberous sclerosis. It is characterized by a mixture of epithelioid cells, smooth muscle, vessels, and mature adipose tissue. The kidney is the most common site of involvement. Other sites of involvement include t...

concepts.label: pericytic neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the perivascular cells of the connective and soft tissues. It is characterized by the presence of pericytes that grow in a circumferential pattern around vessels.

concepts.label: hepatic angiomyolipoma
concepts.description: An angiomyolipoma arising from the liver.

concepts.label: epithelioid type angiomyolipoma
concepts.description: An angiomyolipoma composed exclusively or predominantly by polygonal epithelioid cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, often associated with cytologic atypia.

concepts.label: purpura
concepts.description: A small blood vessel hemorrhage into the skin and/or mucous membranes. Newer lesions appear reddish in color. Older lesions are usually a darker purple color and eventually become a brownish-yellow color.

concepts.label: frontal lobe epilepsy
concepts.description: A localization-related (focal) form of epilepsy characterized by seizures which arise in the frontal lobe. A variety of clinical syndromes exist depending on the exact location of the seizure focus. Frontal lobe seizures may be idiopathic (cryptogenic) or caused by an identifiable disease process...

concepts.label: bone inflammation disease
concepts.description: Inflammation of the bone.

concepts.label: xanthomatosis
concepts.description: A condition marked by the development of widespread xanthomas, yellow tumor-like structures filled with lipid deposits. concepts.label: mesenchymal cell neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign, intermediate, or malignant neoplasm that arises from the mesenchyma-derived cells of the soft tissue or bone. Representative examples include lipoma, leiomyoma, leiomyosarcoma and osteosarcoma.

concepts.label: bone angiosarcoma
concepts.description: A high-grade malignant vascular neoplasm that arises from the bone. It is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells with endothelial differentiation.

concepts.label: undifferentiated high grade pleomorphic sarcoma of bone
concepts.description: A rare, high-grade pleomorphic malignant neoplasm arising from the bone. It usually presents with pain which may or may not be associated with swelling in the affected area. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped cells, polygonal or epithelioid cells, multinucleated giant cells, an...
synonyms: malignant fibrous histiocytoma of the bone
undifferentiated high grade pleomorphic sarcoma of bone

concepts.label: bone fibrosarcoma
concepts.description: A usually aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the bone. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.

concepts.label: extraosseous osteosarcoma
concepts.description: An osteosarcoma arising from the soft tissue.

concepts.label: pediatric osteosarcoma
concepts.description: An osteosarcoma occurring in childhood.

concepts.label: bone leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A rare aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the bone. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: Ewing sarcoma of bone
concepts.description: A small round cell bone tumor that lacks morphologic, immunohistochemical, and electron microscopic evidence of neuroectodermal differentiation. It represents one of the two ends of the spectrum called Ewing sarcoma/peripheral neuroectodermal tumor. It often affects the diaphysis or metaphyseal-d...
synonyms: Ewing's sarcoma/bone peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumour

concepts.label: chondroblastic osteosarcoma
concepts.description: An osteosarcoma characterized by the presence of atypical cartilage of variable cellularity. It may or may not be associated with the presence of myxoid areas or focal bone formation.

concepts.label: peripheral osteosarcoma
concepts.description: A usually aggressive malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the surface of the bone.

concepts.label: bone osteosarcoma
concepts.description: A usually aggressive malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the bone. It may arise de novo or from a pre-existing lesion of the bone. Pain and a palpable mass are the most frequent clinical sign and symptom. It may spread to other anatomic sites, particularly the lungs.

concepts.label: small cell osteogenic sarcoma
concepts.description: An osteosarcoma usually arising from the metaphysis of long bones. It is characterized by the presence of small cells and osteoid production. The prognosis is usually unfavorable.

concepts.label: conventional osteosarcoma
concepts.description: A high grade malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm producing osteoid. The tumor arises from the medullary portion of the bone. concepts.label: metachronous osteosarcoma of the bone
concepts.description: A bone osteosarcoma that has metastasized to skeletal or extraskeletal sites.

concepts.label: cranial nerve neoplasm
concepts.description: Abnormal growth of the cells that comprise the cranial nerves.

concepts.label: liposarcoma of bone
concepts.description: A very rare malignant adipose tissue neoplasm that arises from the bone.

concepts.label: periodontal disorder
concepts.description: An inflammatory process of the gingival tissues and/or periodontal membrane of the teeth, resulting in an abnormally deep gingival sulcus, possibly producing periodontal pockets and loss of alveolar bone support.

concepts.label: histiocytosis
concepts.description: A morphologic finding indicating tissue infiltration by non-neoplastic or neoplastic histiocytes.

concepts.label: glossopharyngeal nerve neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm involving a glossopharyngeal nerve.
synonyms: neoplasm of the Ninth cranial nerve
tumor of the Ninth cranial nerve
tumour of the Ninth cranial nerve

concepts.label: glossopharyngeal nerve disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the glossopharyngeal nerve.
synonyms: disease or disorder of glossopharyngeal nerve

concepts.label: optic nerve neoplasm
concepts.description: Benign and malignant neoplasms which arise from or metastasize to the optic or second cranial nerve which extends from the optic disk of the eye and joins the optic chiasm. Clinical features may include visual loss, proptosis, and local pain. The majority of optic nerve tumors or optic gliomas.
synonyms: neoplasm of the second cranial nerve
tumor of the second cranial nerve
tumour of the second cranial nerve

concepts.label: vestibular disorder
concepts.description: Pathological processes of the vestibular labyrinth which contains part of the balancing apparatus. Patients with vestibular diseases show instability and are at risk of frequent falls.
synonyms: disease or disorder of vestibular labyrinth

concepts.label: idiopathic granulomatous myositis
concepts.description: Class

concepts.label: laryngitis
concepts.description: An acute or chronic, bacterial or viral inflammatory process affecting the larynx. Signs and symptoms include sore throat, cough, swallowing difficulties, and hoarseness.

concepts.label: mammary Paget disease
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm in which there is infiltration of the skin overlying the breast by neoplastic large cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and large nuclei with prominent nucleoli (Paget cells). It is almost always associated with an intraductal or invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast. The cl...

concepts.label: anal Paget disease
concepts.description: A slowly spreading, erythematous eczematoid plaque in the anal region. Histologically, the basal part or whole thickness of the squamous epithelium is infiltrated by large cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and large nuclei. Half of the cases are associated with an internal malignancy, most often...

concepts.label: anus adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma arising in the anal canal epithelium, including the mucosal surface, the anal glands, and the lining of fistulous tracts. The prognosis is related to the stage at diagnosis.

concepts.label: Paget disease of the penis
concepts.description: A premalignant condition morphologically characterized by the presence of the characteristic Paget cells in the intraepithelial tissue of the penis. It presents as a smooth raised reddish area that may or may not be painful. -- 2003

concepts.label: uterine disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the uterine corpus or the cervix. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include endometritis and cervicitis. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include endometrial carcinoma, carcinosarcoma, and cervical carcinoma.

concepts.label: cutaneous Paget disease
concepts.description: A skin carcinoma that is characterized by infiltration of the skin by neoplastic large cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and large nuclei with prominent nucleoli.

concepts.label: skin carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the zone of skin

concepts.label: breast disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the breast.

concepts.label: iris cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the iris.

concepts.label: uveal cancer
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the choroid, ciliary body, or iris.

concepts.label: uveal disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the uvea. Representative examples include uveitis, chorioretinitis, and uveal melanoma.

concepts.label: extrahepatic bile duct signet ring cell carcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts. It is characterized by the presence of signet ring malignant epithelial cells.

synonyms: adenocarcinoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

concepts.label: pancreatic signet ring cell adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A rare pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with poor prognosis. It is characterized by the presence of malignant signet ring cells infiltrating the pancreatic parenchyma in an individual cell pattern.
synonyms: signet Ring cell carcinoma of pancreas
signet Ring cell carcinoma of the pancreas

concepts.label: gallbladder signet ring cell adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the gallbladder. It is characterized by the presence of signet ring malignant epithelial cells.
synonyms: gall bladder signet ring cell carcinoma
signet Ring cell carcinoma of gallbladder
signet Ring cell carcinoma of the gallbladder

concepts.label: ampullary signet ring cell adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma arising from the ampulla of Vater. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of mucin-containing signet-ring cells.
synonyms: ampulla of Vater signet Ring cell carcinoma

concepts.label: ampulla of vater adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the hepatopancreatic ampulla
synonyms: invasive adenocarcinoma of the ampullary region

concepts.label: acinar prostate adenocarcinoma, signet ring variant
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of acinar adenocarcinoma of the prostate gland characterized by the presence of signet ring malignant cells.

concepts.label: adult fibrosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm composed of fibroblasts. It is characterized by collagen production and a herringbone architectural pattern. It is more commonly seen in middle-aged and older adults. It usually affects the deep soft tissues of extremities, trunk, head and neck. Adult fibrosarcoma...

concepts.label: conventional fibrosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm composed of fibroblasts, and characterized by collagen production and usually a herringbone architectural pattern.

concepts.label: pediatric fibrosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm arising from the deep soft tissues in children. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.

concepts.label: choroid plexus cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the choroid plexus
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of the choroid plexus
malignant tumor of the choroid plexus
malignant tumour of the choroid plexus

concepts.label: cerebral ventricle cancer
concepts.description: A neoplasm that involves a brain ventricle. It may be a primary neoplasm arising from a brain ventricle, a metastasis from a distant anatomic site, or an extension of an invasive neoplasm from an adjacent brain structure.

concepts.label: adult choroid plexus neoplasm
concepts.description: A choroid plexus neoplasm that occurs in an adult.
synonyms: neoplasm of the adult choroid plexus
tumor of the adult choroid plexus
tumour of the adult choroid plexus

concepts.label: atypical choroid plexus papilloma
concepts.description: A choroid plexus papilloma characterized by increased mitotic activity.

concepts.label: childhood choroid plexus carcinoma
concepts.description: A choroid plexus carcinoma that occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: superior mesenteric artery syndrome
concepts.description: Superior mesenteric artery syndrome (SMAS) is a digestive condition that occurs when the duodenum (the first part of the small intestine) is compressed between two arteries (the aorta and the superior mesenteric artery). synonyms: syndromic disease of superior mesenteric artery

concepts.label: duodenal obstruction
concepts.description: Blockage of the normal flow of stomach contents through the duodenum.

concepts.label: liver cancer
concepts.description: An epithelial or non-epithelial malignant neoplasm that arises from the liver. Representative examples include hepatocellular carcinoma, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma.
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of liver, not specified as primary or secondary

concepts.label: Sertoli cell tumor
concepts.description: A sex cord-stromal tumor of the testis or the ovary. It is characterized by the presence of Sertoli cells forming tubules. Leydig cells are rare or absent. concepts.label: ovarian gonadoblastoma
concepts.description: A neoplasm that arises from the ovary and is composed of tissues that resemble dysgerminoma or seminoma and are admixed with sex cord tissues. It is found in children or young adults and usually is associated with secondary sex organs abnormalities. The majority of patients present as phenotypic ...

concepts.label: testicular gonadoblastoma
concepts.description: A testicular mixed germ cell-sex cord-stromal tumor. It is usually associated with mixed gonadal dysgenesis and ambiguous genitalia. It is characterized by the presence of nests of large neoplastic germ cells and immature cells that resemble Sertoli cells.

concepts.label: ovarian mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An invasive cystic adenocarcinoma arising from the ovary. It is characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells which contain intracytoplasmic mucin. concepts.label: ovarian cystadenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of cystic structures. It includes the serous cystadenocarcinoma, mucinous cystadenocarcinoma, and clear cell cystadenocarcinoma.

concepts.description: Ischemic or hemorrhagic necrosis of the pituitary gland.

concepts.label: mast cell neoplasm
concepts.description: A heterogeneous group of disorders characterized by the abnormal growth and accumulation of mast cells in one or more organ systems. Recent data suggest that most variants of mast cell neoplasms are clonal disorders. (WHO, 2001)

concepts.label: cutaneous solitary mastocytoma
concepts.description: A variant of cutaneous mastocytosis which occurs as a single lesion usually in infants. It is found mostly in the wrist and trunk and there is no atypical cytomorphology.

concepts.label: olfactory nerve disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the olfactory nerve.
synonyms: disease or disorder of olfactory nerve

concepts.label: rhabdoid tumor
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant embryonal neoplasm usually occurring during childhood. concepts.label: rhabdoid tumor of the kidney
concepts.description: A rhabdoid tumor that arises from the kidney. It occurs in children and it is associated with abnormalities of chromosome 22. It is characterized by the presence of cells with a large eccentric nucleus, prominent nucleolus, and abundant cytoplasm. The prognosis is poor.
synonyms: malignant rhabdoid tumor of the kidney
malignant rhabdoid tumour of the kidney

concepts.label: childhood kidney neoplasm
concepts.description: A kidney neoplasm that occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: cerebral hemisphere cancer
concepts.description: A cancer that involves the cerebral hemisphere.
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of the cerebral hemispheres
malignant tumor of the cerebral hemispheres
malignant tumour of the cerebral hemispheres

concepts.label: lung benign neoplasm
concepts.description: A non-metastasizing neoplasm that arises from the lung parenchyma or the bronchi. Representative examples include lung adenoma, lung hamartoma, and endobronchial lipoma.

concepts.label: anal mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An anal adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of mucoid stroma formation.

concepts.label: anal canal adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An anal adenocarcinoma arising from the anal canal mucosa. Morphologically, it resembles the adenocarcinoma which arises from the colorectal glandular epithelium. Symptoms include anal pruritus, discomfort when sitting, pain, change in bowel habit, and bleeding.
synonyms: adenocarcinoma arising in the anal mucosa

concepts.label: ampulla of vater mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma with glandular differentiation arising from the ampulla of Vater. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of mucoid stroma formation.

concepts.label: uterine ligament mucinous adenocarcinoma

concepts.label: uterine ligament adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A rare adenocarcinoma that arises from the uterine ligament.

concepts.label: cervical mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A usually well to moderately differentiated cervical adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells that contain significant amount of intracytoplasmic mucin.

concepts.label: fallopian tube mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An extremely rare adenocarcinoma that arises from the fallopian tube. It is characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that contain intracytoplasmic mucin. The cases that have been reported are predominantly in situ mucinous adenocarcinomas.

concepts.label: fallopian tube mucinous tumor
concepts.description: A rare borderline or malignant epithelial tumor of the fallopian tube characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that contain intracytoplasmic mucin and may resemble the epithelial cells of the endocervix or gastrointestinal tract.

concepts.label: fallopian tube adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the fallopian tube

concepts.label: rectum mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An invasive adenocarcinoma of the rectum characterized by the presence of pools of extracellular mucin. Malignant glandular epithelial cells are present in the mucin collections. Mucin constitutes more than 50% of the lesion.

concepts.label: extracranial neuroblastoma
concepts.description: A neuroblastoma arising from an anatomic site other than the brain.

concepts.label: bladder adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the urinary bladder

concepts.label: ovarian adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary. It is the most common type of ovarian carcinoma. It includes the serous adenocarcinoma, mucinous adenocarcinoma, clear cell adenocarcinoma, and endometrioid adenocarcinoma.

concepts.label: extramedullary plasmacytoma
concepts.description: A plasma cell neoplasm arising at an extraosseous site. There is no involvement of the bone marrow. It most frequently involves the oropharynx, nasopharynx, sinuses, and larynx. Other sites of involvement include the gastrointestinal tract, central nervous system, breast, skin, lymph nodes, and b...

concepts.label: solitary osseous plasmacytoma
concepts.description: A localized, clonal (malignant) plasma cell infiltrate in the bone, without peripheral blood involvement. The most commonly affected bones are the vertebrae, ribs, skull, pelvis and femur. X-rays examination reveals a solitary lytic lesion.

concepts.label: solitary plasmacytoma of chest wall
concepts.description: A solitary plasmacytoma that arises from the chest wall.
synonyms: solitary plasmacytoma of the chest wall

concepts.label: vulva verrucous carcinoma
concepts.description: A highly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva. concepts.label: bladder squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A squamous cell carcinoma of the bladder arising from metaplastic epithelium. It represents less than 10% of bladder carcinomas. concepts.label: cervical verrucous carcinoma
concepts.description: A highly differentiated variant of cervical squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of a warty surface and stromal invasion with pushing borders. The malignant cells have abundant cytoplasm and minimal nuclear atypia. Koilocytosis is not present.

concepts.label: esophagus verrucous carcinoma
concepts.description: A rare variant of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. It is an exophytic, cauliflower-like or papillary mass that can arise in any part of the esophagus. This variant of squamous cell carcinoma grows slowly and invades locally, with a very low metastasizing potential. (WHO)

concepts.label: urethral verrucous carcinoma
concepts.description: A verrucous carcinoma that involves the urethra.

concepts.label: urethra squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A well differentiated, moderately differentiated, or poorly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the male or female urethra.
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of the urethra

concepts.label: larynx verrucous carcinoma
concepts.description: A well differentaited, non-metastasizing squamous cell carcinoma arising from the larynx. It is an exophytic, warty, and slow growing tumor affecting predominantly older men. concepts.label: true hermaphroditism
concepts.description: A rare condition characterized by the unequivocal presence of both testicular and ovarian tissues in an individual. It is usually manifested with ambiguous external genitalia.

concepts.label: pulmonary fibrosis
concepts.description: Chronic progressive interstitial lung disorder characterized by the replacement of the lung tissue by connective tissue, leading to progressive dyspnea, respiratory failure, or right heart failure. concepts.label: intraventricular meningioma

concepts.label: skull base neoplasm

concepts.label: diencephalic cancer

concepts.label: adamantinous craniopharyngioma
concepts.description: A craniopharyngioma consisting of broad strands, cords and bridges of a multistratified squamous epithelium with peripheral palisading of nuclei. Diagnostic features include nodules of compact 'wet' keratin and dystrophic calcification. (Adapted from WHO)

concepts.label: papillary craniopharyngioma
concepts.description: A craniopharyngioma composed of sheets of squamous epithelium which separate to form pseudopapillae. concepts.label: hemangiopericytic tumor
concepts.description: A term that refers to vascular neoplasms with a prominent hemangiopericytic growth pattern.

concepts.label: large cell medulloblastoma
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma composed of large cells with prominent nucleoli and a larger amount of cytoplasm in contrast with the cells of the classic medulloblastoma.

concepts.label: cerebellar vermis medulloblastoma
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma arising from the vermis of the cerebellum.

concepts.label: adult medulloblastoma
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma arising from the brain, occurring in adults.

concepts.label: colonic pseudo-obstruction
concepts.description: Functional obstruction of the colon leading to megacolon in the absence of obvious colonic diseases or mechanical obstruction. concepts.description: Chronic or recurrent colonic disorders without an identifiable structural or biochemical explanation. The widely recognized irritable bowel syndrome falls into this category.

concepts.description: Intestinal pseudo-obstruction is a digestive disorder in whichthe intestinal walls are unable to contract normally (called hypomotility); the conditionresembles a true obstruction, but no actual blockage exists. concepts.label: bronchogenic carcinoma

concepts.label: pancreatic cystadenoma

concepts.description: A benign or malignant epithelial neoplasm that is usually cystic and arises from the exocrine pancreas. concepts.description: The sudden onset of inflammation of heart muscle with myocellular necrosis; this is generally secondary to an infectious cause, and patients often have a recent history of a flu-like illness.

concepts.label: bartholin gland carcinoma

concepts.label: non-keratinizing sinonasal squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A squamous cell carcinoma of the sinonasal tract characterized by a plexiform or ribbon-like growth pattern, cytological atypia, and lack of histological evidence of keratinization.

concepts.label: endometrial transitional cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A rare primary carcinoma of the endometrium characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells resembling urothelial transitional cells. The malignant transitional cells constitute at least 90% of the tumor cells.

concepts.label: fallopian tube transitional cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A rare transitional cell carcinoma that arises from the fallopian tube.

concepts.label: primary prostate urothelial carcinoma
concepts.description: An urothelial carcinoma that arises from the urothelial lining of the prostatic ducts or the prostatic urethra.

concepts.label: urethra transitional cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A transitional cell carcinoma that arises from the male or female urethra.

concepts.label: sarcomatoid transitional cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A poorly differentiated transitional cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant cells with spindle cell morphologic features.

concepts.label: eosinophilic gastritis
concepts.description: An eosinophilic gastroenteritis that is characterized by inflammation of the stomach.

concepts.label: skeletal muscle cancer

concepts.label: mediastinum rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the mediastinum.

concepts.label: mediastinum sarcoma
concepts.description: A rare sarcoma that arises from the mediastinum. Examples include liposarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, and angiosarcoma.

concepts.label: rectum rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the rectum.

concepts.label: prostate sarcoma
concepts.description: A rare malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the prostate gland. Representative examples include leiomyosarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and stromal sarcoma.

concepts.label: ectomesenchymoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant mesenchymal neoplasm of the nervous system or soft tissues. It is characterized by the presence of a sarcomatous component (most often rhabdomyosarcoma) and a ganglionic or a neuroectodermal component.
synonyms: sarcoma with ganglionic or neuroectodermal differentiation

concepts.label: gallbladder rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A rhabdomyosarcoma that is located in the gallbladder.

concepts.label: gallbladder sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the gallbladder. Representative examples include Kaposi sarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, and rhabdomyosarcoma.

concepts.label: ovary rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the ovaries.

concepts.label: breast rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the breast.

concepts.label: testis rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the testis.

concepts.label: testis sarcoma
concepts.description: A sarcoma that arises from the testis. The majority of cases arise from teratomas or spermatocytic seminomas.

concepts.label: bile duct sarcoma
concepts.description: A sarcoma that involves the bile duct.

concepts.label: duodenal disorder

concepts.label: pancreatic cystadenocarcinoma

concepts.label: heart valve disorder

concepts.label: testicular trophoblastic tumor
concepts.description: A tumor that arises from the testis and is composed of neoplastic trophoblastic cells. The vast majority of cases are choriocarcinomas.

concepts.label: trophoblastic neoplasm
concepts.description: A gestational or non-gestational neoplasm composed of neoplastic trophoblastic cells. Representative examples include hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma.

concepts.label: testicular pure germ cell tumor
concepts.description: A germ cell tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of one histologic component. This category includes seminoma, teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and trophoblastic tumor.

concepts.label: parasitic ectoparasitic infectious disease
concepts.description: Infestations by parasites which live on, or burrow into, the surface of their host's epidermis. Most ectoparasites are arthropods.

concepts.label: cervical adenosarcoma
concepts.description: A rare malignant mixed epithelial and mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the cervix and is characterized by the presence of malignant mesenchymal elements and benign epithelial elements.

concepts.label: cervical carcinosarcoma

concepts.description: A neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the colon. It includes well differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (low and intermediate grade) and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (high grade).

concepts.description: A slow-growing malignant bone tumor arising from the remnants of the notochord and occurring in the spine. It is characterized by a lobulated growth pattern, myxoid stroma formation, and the presence of physaliphorous cells.

concepts.label: primary syphilis

concepts.label: diencephalic astrocytomas

concepts.label: pineal gland astrocytoma
concepts.description: A astrocytoma that involves the pineal body.

concepts.label: brain stem astrocytic neoplasm
concepts.description: An astrocytoma that arises from the brain stem.

concepts.label: spinal cord astrocytoma

concepts.label: salivary gland adenoid cystic carcinoma
concepts.description: An adenoid cystic carcinoma arising from the salivary gland. It is characterized by the presence of epithelial and myoepithelial cells forming tubular, cribriform, and solid patterns. It usually presents as a slow growing mass. synonyms: adenoid cystic carcinoma of the breast

concepts.label: esophageal adenoid cystic carcinoma

concepts.label: peritoneal serous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A rare, serous adenocarcinoma that arises from the lining of the peritoneum. It affects females. The clinical behavior and pathologic characteristics are similar to the serous adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary.

concepts.label: appendix carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the vermiform appendix

concepts.label: granular cell carcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells with granular cytoplasm.

concepts.label: small intestine adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the small intestine. Histologic variants include mucinous adenocarcinoma and signet ring cell carcinoma.

concepts.label: anal carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the anus

concepts.label: thymus gland adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A rare primary thymic carcinoma, characterized by the presence of carcinoma cells with glandular differentiation.

concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from the intrahepatic bile duct epithelium in any site of the intrahepatic biliary tree. Grossly, the malignant lesions are solid, nodular, and grayish. concepts.label: nasal cavity carcinoma

concepts.description: A carcinoma with apocrine differentiation arising from the sweat glands. concepts.label: prosopagnosia
concepts.description: Impaired ability to recognize other human faces in the absence of a vision disorder. It may be a congenital disorder or the result of brain injury.

concepts.label: acute nonparalytic poliomyelitis
concepts.description: A poliomyelitis that does not exhibit paralysis.

concepts.label: optic nerve astrocytoma

concepts.label: vulvar granular cell tumor
concepts.description: A usually benign granular cell tumor that arises from the vulva.

concepts.description: A generally benign intrasellar and/or suprasellar mass arising from the neurohypophysis or infundibulum. concepts.description: A low-grade neoplasm that arises from the neurohypophysis. It includes the granular cell tumor of the neurohypophysis and pituicytoma.

concepts.label: rhabdoid meningioma
concepts.description: A WHO grade III meningioma characterized by the predominant presence of rhabdoid cells forming sheets.

concepts.label: childhood cerebellar neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm that affects the cerebellum and occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: ependymal tumor
concepts.description: A group of neoplasms which arise from the ependymal lining of the cerebral ventricles and from the remnants of the central canal of the spinal cord. concepts.label: mixed glioma
concepts.description: A tumor composed of two or more glial cell types (astrocytes, ependymal cells, and oligodendrocytes).

concepts.label: sternum cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the sternum

concepts.label: fallopian tube leiomyoma
concepts.description: A benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the fallopian tube. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

concepts.label: bizarre leiomyoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of leiomyoma characterized by the presence of pleomorphic muscle cells with bizarre hyperchromatic nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm.

concepts.label: leiomyoma cutis
concepts.description: A benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the arrector pili muscle, tunica media of blood vessels, and dartos muscle of the genitalia. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

concepts.label: leiomyomatosis
concepts.description: A condition characterized by the presence of numerous small benign smooth muscle neoplasms located throughout the body.

concepts.label: cellular leiomyoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of classic leiomyoma characterized by a dense cellular infiltrate composed of spindle or round cells with scant cytoplasm and a less obvious interlacing fascicle pattern.

concepts.label: colorectal leiomyoma
concepts.description: A well-circumscribed benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the colorectal area. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

concepts.label: appendix leiomyoma
concepts.description: A well-circumscribed benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the appendix. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

concepts.label: dartoic leiomyoma
concepts.description: A cutaneous leiomyoma arising from the dartos muscle of the scrotum or labia majora.

concepts.label: epithelioid neurofibroma
concepts.description: A rare neurofibroma with epithelioid morphology.

concepts.label: neurofibroma of gallbladder
concepts.description: A non-metastasizing encapsulated neoplasm arising from nerves in the gallbladder. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of fibroblasts and Schwann cells.

concepts.label: plexiform neurofibroma
concepts.description: An elongated and multinodular neurofibroma, formed when the tumor involves either multiple trunks of a plexus or multiple fascicles of a large nerve, such as the sciatic. Some plexiform neurofibromas resemble a bag of worms, others produce a massive ropy enlargement of the nerve. (Adapted from WHO.)

concepts.label: cellular neurofibroma
concepts.description: A neurofibroma characterized by the presence of areas with increased cellularity.

concepts.label: atypical neurofibroma
concepts.description: A neurofibroma characterized by the presence of cellular pleomorphism.

concepts.label: pleural mesothelioma
concepts.description: A neoplasm that arises from the mesothelial cells of the pleura. The primary cause is exposure to asbestos. concepts.label: endometrial stromal tumor
concepts.description: Neoplasms of the endometrial stroma that sometimes involve the myometrium. These tumors contain cells that may closely or remotely resemble the normal stromal cells. concepts.label: endometrioid stromal sarcoma of the vagina
concepts.description: A rare sarcoma that arises from the vagina. This category includes low grade endometrioid stromal sarcoma and undifferentiated vaginal sarcoma.
synonyms: endometrioid stromal sarcoma of the vagina

concepts.label: endometrioid stromal and related neoplasms of the vagina
concepts.description: A category of rare neoplasms that arise from the vagina. It includes low grade endometrioid stromal sarcoma and undifferentiated sarcoma.

metachronous Wilms tumour of the kidney

concepts.label: mixed cell type kidney Wilms' tumor
concepts.description: Wilms tumor of the kidney characterized by the presence of blastema, epithelial, and mesenchymal components (triphasic pattern) or a combination of two of them (biphasic pattern).

concepts.label: hereditary Wilms tumor
concepts.description: Familial embryonal neoplasm derived from nephrogenic blastemal cells. Several lines of differentiation, including blastemal, stromal and epithelial, are usually expressed. Comprises approximately 1% of Wilms tumors. (AFIP fascicle version 2.0)

concepts.label: epithelial predominant Wilms' tumor
concepts.description: Wilms tumor of the kidney characterized by the predominance of the epithelial component. The epithelial cells may form papillary and tubular patterns and pseudorosettes.

concepts.label: nodular ganglioneuroblastoma
concepts.description: A ganglioneuroblastoma characterized by the presence of neuroblastic cells in a Schwannian stroma, and the formation of hemorrhagic neuroblastic nodules.

concepts.label: intermixed schwannian stroma-rich ganglioneuroblastoma
concepts.description: A ganglioneuroblastoma characterized by the presence of neuroblastic cells in a Schwannian stroma, without the presence of hemorrhagic neuroblastic nodules.

concepts.label: peripheral ganglioneuroblastoma
concepts.description: A ganglioneuroblastoma arising from the peripheral nervous system.

concepts.label: fallopian tube adenomatoid tumor
concepts.description: A benign neoplasm that arises from the fallopian tube and originates from mesothelial cells. It is characterized by the presence of gland-like structures that are lined by flat or cuboidal cells. It is usually discovered as an incidental finding.

concepts.label: ovarian monodermal teratoma
concepts.description: A teratoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of tissues derived exclusively from one embryonic germ cell layer.

concepts.label: malignant struma ovarii
concepts.description: An ovarian mature teratoma characterized by the presence of aberrant thyroid tissue with morphologic changes identical to thyroid carcinoma. Patients may present with abdominal mass and unusual symptoms due to thyrotoxicosis, or with Meigs syndrome (ascites and pleural effusion).

concepts.label: benign struma ovarii
concepts.description: A mature monodermal teratoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of benign, thyroid-type tissues.

concepts.label: demyelinating polyneuropathy
concepts.description: Polyneuropathy that is characterized by demyelination of axons.

concepts.label: chronic polyneuropathy
concepts.description: Polyneuropathy that is persistent or long-standing in nature.

concepts.label: acute necrotizing encephalitis
concepts.description: A fulminant and often fatal demyelinating disease of the brain which primarily affects young adults and children. concepts.label: acute hemorrhagic encephalitis
concepts.description: Acute encephalitis that is characterized by bleeding.

concepts.label: malignant glomus tumor
concepts.description: A very rare morphologic variant of glomus tumor with a size greater than 2 cm. The tumor arises in subfascial or visceral tissues. It is characterized by the presence of atypical mitotic figures, or marked nuclear atypia, or the combination of both. It has an aggressive clinical course.

concepts.label: subungual glomus tumor
concepts.description: A glomus tumor arising in the finger and usually associated with pain.

concepts.label: benign perivascular tumor
concepts.description: A benign mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the perivascular cells of the connective and soft tissues. It is characterized by the presence of pericytes that grow in a circumferential pattern around vessels.

concepts.label: retinal hemangioblastoma
concepts.description: A hemangioblastoma that arises from the retina. It is typically a sign of von Hippel-Lindau disease. It may also be seen as an isolated entity without systemic involvement.

concepts.label: hilar cholangiocarcinoma
concepts.description: A cholangiocarcinoma that arises from the junction, or adjacent to the junction, of the right and left hepatic ducts.
synonyms: cholangiocarcinoma of hilar portion of hepatic duct
hilar portion of hepatic duct cholangiocarcinoma

concepts.label: central nervous system vasculitis
concepts.description: Vasculitis affecting the blood vessels of the brain and/or spinal cord.

concepts.label: inflammatory leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of leiomyosarcoma characterized by the presence of an inflammatory infiltrate admixed with malignant spindle cells.

concepts.label: conventional leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An uncommon, aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm. It is characterized by the presence of atypical large spindle or round cells, nuclear palisading, tumor cell necrosis, mitotic figures and may be associated with vascular invasion.

concepts.label: central nervous system leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the central nervous system. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.
synonyms: leiomyosarcoma of the central nervous system

concepts.label: granular cell leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm. It is characterized by the presence of malignant smooth muscle cells with granular cytoplasmic changes.

concepts.label: colon leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm that arises from the colon. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: colon sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the colon. Representative examples include angiosarcoma, Kaposi sarcoma, and leiomyosarcoma.

concepts.label: heart leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the heart. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: heart sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the heart. The majority of cases are angiosarcomas.

concepts.label: ovary leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the ovary. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: epithelioid leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of leiomyosarcoma characterized by the presence of epithelioid round cells with eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm.

concepts.label: lung leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the lung. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: anus leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the anus. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: myxoid leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of leiomyosarcoma characterized by the presence of cellular pleomorphism, malignant cells with large nuclei, and a myxoid stroma.

concepts.label: small intestine leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the small intestine. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: small intestinal sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the small intestine. Representative examples include leiomyosarcoma, angiosarcoma, and Kaposi sarcoma.

concepts.label: cutaneous leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the skin. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: malignant dermis tumor
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the dermis.

concepts.label: gallbladder leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the gallbladder. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: esophagus leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the esophagus. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: gastric leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the stomach. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: prostate leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the prostate. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: vagina leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the vagina. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: retroperitoneal leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the retroperitoneum. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: breast leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the breast. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: vulvar leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the vulva. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: kidney leiomyosarcoma

concepts.label: ovarian mucinous adenocarcinofibroma
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm of the ovary with an invasive epithelial component and a fibrotic stroma. The epithelial component is characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells with intracytoplasmic mucin. Cystic spaces are also present which contain mucoid material.

concepts.label: epicardium lipoma
concepts.description: A rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the epicardium of the heart.

concepts.label: heart lipoma
concepts.description: A rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the heart usually originating in the epicardial or pericardial fatty tissue.

concepts.label: childhood cerebellar astrocytic neoplasm
concepts.description: Benign and malignant astrocytomas that arise from astrocytes in the cerebellum. More than 80% of childhood cerebellar astrocytomas are pilocytic astrocytomas which have a favorable prognosis. The remainder are composed of diffuse or fibrillary subtypes with malignant astrocytomas occurring only r...

concepts.label: central nervous system lipoma
concepts.description: A rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the central nervous system frequently found in midline locations such as the corpus callosum, the quadrigeminal plate, the hypothalamus, the spinal canal or the cauda equina. Some contain Schwann cells, bone, cartilage or hamartomatous blood vessels.
synonyms: lipoma of the central nervous system

concepts.label: hereditary disease
concepts.description: A disease that is caused by genetic modifications where those modifications are inherited from a parent's genome.

concepts.label: ectopic thymus
concepts.description: A condition in which the thymus gland is abnomally located; this can be secondary to failure of descent during fetal development, or failure of involution.

concepts.label: clivus chordoma
concepts.description: A slow-growing malignant bone tumor arising from the remnants of the notochord and occurring in the clivus. It is characterized by a lobulated growth pattern, myxoid stroma formation, and the presence of physaliphorous cells.
synonyms: chordoma (disease) of clivus of occipital bone

concepts.label: clivus chondroid chordoma
concepts.description: A slow-growing malignant bone tumor arising from the remnants of the notochord and occurring in the clivus. It is characterized by a lobulated growth pattern, myxoid stroma formation, the presence of physaliphorous cells and cartilage.
synonyms: chondroid chordoma of clivus of occipital bone
clivus of occipital bone chondroid chordoma

concepts.label: ovarian fetiform teratoma
concepts.description: A rare type of teratoma that arises from the ovary and resembles a malformed fetus.

concepts.label: ovarian solid teratoma
concepts.description: A mature teratoma that arises from the ovary and presents as a large solid mass. It contains multiple cysts that vary in size. Small foci of hemorrhage are also present.

concepts.label: Bartholin gland adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the major vestibular gland.

concepts.label: adult malignant hemangiopericytoma
concepts.description: A malignant hemangiopericytoma occurring in the adult population.

concepts.label: vulvar eccrine adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An eccrine adenocarcinoma that arises from the sweat glands in the vulva.

concepts.label: liver extraskeletal osteosarcoma
concepts.description: An osteosarcoma arising from the liver.

concepts.label: diffuse meningeal melanocytosis
concepts.description: A diffuse or multifocal proliferation of uniform nevoid polygonal cells in the leptomeninges. Cells may spread into the Virchow-Robin spaces without frank invasion of the brain. Diffuse melanocytosis carries a poor prognosis even in the absence of histologic malignancy. (WHO)

concepts.label: anterior foramen magnum meningioma
concepts.description: A meningioma that affects the anterior foramen magnum.
synonyms: meningioma of the anterior Foramen magnum

concepts.label: childhood brain stem glioma
concepts.description: An abnormal growth of the cells that comprise the tissues of the brainstem. While the tumor may be histologically benign, it can produce great morbidity due to its location. It presents most commonly in the first two decades of life.
synonyms: childhood glioma of the brain stem
paediatric glioma of the brain stem
pediatric glioma of the brain stem

concepts.label: childhood brainstem astrocytoma
concepts.description: An astrocytoma that arises from the brain stem and occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: ovarian serous surface papillary adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A serous adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of a papillary architectural pattern.

concepts.label: childhood central nervous system mature teratoma

concepts.label: eyelid carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the eyelid.

concepts.label: malignant choroid melanoma
concepts.description: A uveal melanoma that arises from the choroid. It is the most common primary malignant intraocular tumor. It usually affects Caucasians of northern European descent. concepts.label: ovarian endometrioid adenocarcinofibroma
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells resembling endometrial cells in a fibrotic stroma.

concepts.label: ceruminous carcinoma
concepts.description: An infiltrating adenocarcinoma derived from ceruminous glands in the external auditory canal.

concepts.label: vulvar apocrine adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An apocrine adenocarcinoma that arises from the sweat glands in the vulva.

concepts.label: central nervous system fibrosarcoma
concepts.description: A usually aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the central nervous system. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.
synonyms: fibrosarcoma of the central nervous system

concepts.label: childhood testicular mixed embryonal carcinoma and teratoma
concepts.description: A malignant testicular mixed germ cell neoplasm that occurs during childhood. It is characterized by the presence of embryonal carcinoma and teratoma components.

concepts.label: infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma, clear cell variant
concepts.description: An invasive transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder characterized by the presence of clear cells.
synonyms: infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma, clear cell variant

concepts.label: infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma
concepts.description: An invasive transitional cell carcinoma that arises from the urinary bladder urothelium.

concepts.label: acinar lung adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of lung adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of acinar structures composed of columnar or cuboidal cells. (NCI05)

concepts.description: A melanotic schwannoma that affects the mediastinum.

concepts.description: An intermediate grade malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm with chondroblastic differentiation. concepts.label: breast epithelioid hemangioma

concepts.label: cerebellar hemangioblastoma
concepts.description: A histologically benign tumor, usually cystic with a vascular mural nodule, that is most often found in the cerebellum though it has been reported at other sites within the neuraxis. It is associated with von Hippel-Lindau disease (VHL gene located on chr 3p25-26).

concepts.label: brain stem hemangioblastoma
concepts.description: A hemangioblastoma that involves the brainstem.

concepts.label: ovarian yolk sac tumor, glandular pattern
concepts.description: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of extensive differentiation into endodermal type glandular structures.
synonyms: ovarian yolk Sac tumor, glandular pattern
glandular pattern ovarian yolk sac tumour

concepts.label: ovarian yolk sac tumor, hepatoid pattern
concepts.description: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of extensive differentiation into hepatic tissue.

concepts.label: ovarian yolk sac tumor, polyvesicular vitelline pattern
concepts.description: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of multiple dilated spaces lined by cells that resemble mesothelial cells. The dilated spaces coexist with columnar epithelial tissues.

concepts.label: mixed cell uveal melanoma
concepts.description: A melanoma arising from the choroid, ciliary body, or the iris. It is characterized by the presence of a mixture of spindle A melanoma cells, spindle B melanoma cells, and epithelioid melanoma cells.

concepts.label: malignant ciliary body melanoma
concepts.description: A rare uveal melanoma that arises from the ciliary body. Patients may present with blurred vision, visual field loss, floaters, and ocular pain. The prognosis is usually poor.

concepts.label: choroid mixed cell melanoma

concepts.label: overnutrition
concepts.description: An imbalanced nutritional status resulting from excessive intake of nutrients. Generally, overnutrition generates an energy imbalance between food consumption and energy expenditure leading to disorders such as obesity.

concepts.label: heart lymphoma
concepts.description: An extranodal lymphoma that arises from the heart and/or the pericardium. The majority of the cases are diffuse large B-cell lymphomas. Patients may present with chest pain, heart failure, pericardial effusion, arrhythmia, or syncope.

concepts.label: angiomatous meningioma
concepts.description: A WHO grade I meningioma characterized by the presence of small and medium sized vessels that predominate over the meningioma cells.

concepts.label: posterior foramen magnum meningioma
concepts.description: A meningioma that affects the posterior foramen magnum.
synonyms: meningioma of the posterior Foramen magnum

concepts.label: ovarian clear cell malignant adenofibroma
concepts.description: A carcinoma arising from the ovary. It is characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells with clear cytoplasm in a fibrotic stroma.

concepts.label: ethmoid sinus Schneiderian papilloma
concepts.description: A papilloma that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the ethmoid sinus. It is classified as inverted papilloma and oncocytic papilloma.

concepts.label: adrenal cortex adenoma
concepts.description: A benign neoplasm that can arise from any of the adrenal cortical layers. concepts.description: A benign neoplasm that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the ethmoid sinus. It results from the invagination and proliferation of epithelial cells in the underlying stroma.

concepts.label: neurilemmoma of the pleura

concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm that arises from mesothelial cells in the pleura and shows a diffuse growth pattern. concepts.label: bacterial infectious disease
concepts.description: An acute infectious disorder that is caused by gram positive or gram negative bacteria; representative examples include pneumococcal, streptococcal, salmonella, and meningeal infections.

concepts.label: pneumococcal infection
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the species streptococcus pneumoniae.
synonyms: Streptococcus pneumoniae caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: temporal lobe epilepsy
concepts.description: A localization-related (focal) form of epilepsy characterized by recurrent seizures that arise from foci within the temporal lobe, most commonly from its mesial aspect. concepts.label: Whipple disease
concepts.description: A systemic infection caused by the Gram-positive bacterium Tropheryma whipplei. It affects the small intestine resulting in malabsorption. Other sites or systems affected by the infection are the joints, central nervous system, and the cardiovascular system.
synonyms: Tropheryma whipplei caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: human granulocytic anaplasmosis
concepts.description: A tick-borne, infectious disease caused by Anaplasma phagocytophilum, an obligate intracellular bacterium that is typically transmitted to humans by ticks of the Ixodes ricinus species complex.
synonyms: human anaplasmosis caused by Anaplasma phagocytophilum
human ehrlichial infection, human granulocytic type

concepts.label: anthrax infection
concepts.description: An infection caused by Bacillus anthracis bacteria. It may affect the lungs, gastrointestinal tract, or skin. synonyms: Bacillus anthracis caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: leprosy
concepts.description: Leprosy is a chronic infectious disease affecting primarily the skin and peripheral nervous system.
synonyms: Mycobacterium leprae caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: borderline leprosy
concepts.description: A form of leprosy in which there are clinical manifestations of both principal types (lepromatous and tuberculoid). The disease may shift toward one of these two polar or principal forms.

concepts.description: A principal or polar form of leprosy in which the skin lesions are few and are sharply demarcated. Peripheral nerve involvement is pronounced and may be severe.
