concepts.label: tetrasomy X
concepts.description: Tetrasomy X is a sex chromosome anomaly caused by the presence of two extra X chromosomes in females (48,XXXX instead of 46,XX).

concepts.label: erythema elevatum diutinum
concepts.description: Erythema elevatum diutinum (EED) is a distinctive form of chronic cutaneous vasculitis, belonging to the group of the neutrophilic dermatoses.

concepts.label: undifferentiated connective tissue syndrome
concepts.description: An autoimmune disorder which does not meet classification criteria used to establish the presence of other well-defined connective tissue diseases.

concepts.label: inflammatory pseudotumor of the liver
concepts.description: Inflammatory pseudotumor (IPT) of the liver is a rare benign tumor-like lesion.

concepts.label: radiation myelitis
concepts.description: A disease characterized by white matter damage to the spinal cord developed after a certain period of application of ionizing radiation.

concepts.label: non-syndromic syndactyly
concepts.description: A congenital condition characterized by webbing between the fingers and/or toes, joining the digits together. In rare cases, the joining of the fingers or toes may involve bony fusion between the digits. Common causes include Down Syndrome and hereditary syndactyly.

concepts.label: hemolytic anemia due to glutathione reductase deficiency
concepts.description: Haemolytic anemia due to glutathione reductase (GSR) deficiency is characterized by nearly complete absence of GSR activity in erythrocytes.
synonyms: hemolytic anemia due to glutathione reductase deficiency

concepts.label: autoimmune hemolytic anemia, warm type
concepts.description: Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia is the most common form of autoimmune hemolytic anemia defined by the presence of warm autoantibodies against red blood cells (autoantibodies that are active at temperatures between 37-40B0C).

concepts.label: paroxysmal cold hemoglobinuria
concepts.description: Paroxysmal cold hemoglobinuria (PCH) is a very rare subtype of autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA), caused by the presence of cold-reacting autoantibodies in the blood and characterized by the sudden presence of hemoglobinuria, typically after exposure to cold temperatures.

concepts.label: mixed-type autoimmune hemolytic anemia
concepts.description: Mixed autoimmune hemolytic anemia is a type of autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA) defined by the presence of both warm and cold autoantibodies, which have a deleterious effect on red blood cells at either body temperature or at lower temperatures.

concepts.label: drug-induced autoimmune hemolytic anemia
concepts.description: Drug-induced autoimmune hemolytic anemia is a type of autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA) that occurs as a reaction to therapeutic drugs, and can be due to various mechanisms.

concepts.label: Shiga toxin-associated hemolytic uremic syndrome
concepts.description: A rare thrombotic microangiopathy characterized by mechanical hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, and renal dysfunction that is usually associated with prodromal enteritis caused by Shigella dysentriae type 1 or E. Coli.

concepts.label: hemoglobin D disease
concepts.description: Hemoglobin D disease(HbD) is a hemoglobinopathy characterized by production of abnormal variant hemoglobin known as hemoglobin D, with no or mild clinical manifestations (splenomegaly, very mild anemia).

concepts.label: Gaisbock syndrome
concepts.description: Polycythemia that is caused by stress.

concepts.label: diffuse alveolar hemorrhage
concepts.description: A respiratory disorder characterized by diffuse bleeding into the alveolar spaces that originate from the pulmonary microvasculature, including the alveolar capillaries, arterioles and venules. Patients present with cough, dyspnea, chest pain, fever, anemia and hemoptysis.

concepts.label: acute liver failure
concepts.description: Rapid deterioration of liver function causing encephalopathy and coagulopathy. It results from damage to the liver parenchyma usually secondary to acetaminophen overdose or viral infections.

concepts.label: acquired aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage
concepts.description: A serious, life threatening rare neurologic disease characterized by a sudden rupture of an intracranial aneurysm into the subarachnoid space. concepts.label: chilblain lupus
concepts.description: A rare, chronic cutaneous lupus erythematosus disease characterized by red or violaceous, initially pruritic (evolving to painful) papules and plaques located on acral areas (especially dorsal aspects of fingers and toes, while the nose and ear involvement is uncommon), exacerbated by cold and da...

concepts.description: A chronic, autoimmune skin condition that manifests with a red, scaling rash, most often found on the face, ears, and scalp; these lesions often lead to permanent scarring and dyspigmentation. concepts.description: A type of lupus erythematosus characterized by deep dermal or subcutaneous nodules, most often on the head, face, or upper arms. It is generally chronic and occurs most often in women between the ages of 20 and 45.

concepts.label: localized scleroderma
concepts.description: Localized scleroderma is the skin localized form of scleroderma characterized by fibrosis of the skin causing cutaneous plaques or strips.

concepts.label: CREST syndrome
concepts.description: CREST syndrome is a subtype of limited cutaneous systemic sclerosis (lcSSc) whose name is an acronym for the cardinal clinical features of the syndrome: calcinosis, Raynaud's phenomenon, esophageal dysmotility, sclerodactyly and telangiectasia.

concepts.label: Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, classic type, 1

concepts.label: Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, classic type, 2

concepts.label: Cockayne syndrome type 2
concepts.description: Cockayne syndrome caused by mutation(s) in the ERCC6 gene, encoding DNA excision repair protein ERCC-6.

concepts.label: mixed neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm composed of at least two distinct cellular populations.

concepts.label: fibroepithelial neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign, borderline, or malignant neoplasm characterized by the presence of an epithelial and a fibrous component. Representative examples are fibroadenoma and phyllodes tumor.

concepts.label: breast fibroepithelial neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant biphasic neoplasm that arises from the breast parenchyma. It is characterized by the presence of an epithelial and a mesenchymal (stromal) component. The typical examples are fibroadenoma and phyllodes tumor.

concepts.label: breast phyllodes tumor
concepts.description: A benign, malignant, or borderline circumscribed biphasic neoplasm that arises from the breast. It usually affects middle-aged women. It is characterized by the presence of a double layer of epithelial cells that are arranged in clefts, surrounded by a spindle cell mesenchymal (stromal) component.

concepts.label: benign mastocytoma
concepts.description: A localized mast cell neoplasm without metastatic potential.

concepts.label: vulvar neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the vulva. Representative examples include Bartholin gland adenoma, vulvar nodular hidradenoma, vulvar carcinoma, and vulvar melanoma.

concepts.label: vaginal neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm affecting the vagina. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include squamous papilloma and melanocytic nevus. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma, melanoma, and sarcoma.

concepts.label: parasympathetic paraganglioma
concepts.description: A benign or malignant, usually non-functioning, extra-adrenal paraganglioma that arises from paraganglia located along the parasympathetic nerves. Representative examples include aorticopulmonary, carotid body, jugulotympanic, and mediastinal paragangliomas.

concepts.label: carotid body paraganglioma
concepts.description: A benign or malignant extra-adrenal parasympathetic paraganglioma arising from paraganglia adjacent to or in the bifurcation of the common carotid artery. Most patients present with a slow growing, painless mass in the neck.

concepts.label: bone sarcoma
concepts.description: A sarcoma that arises from the bone. Representative examples are osteosarcoma and chondrosarcoma.

concepts.label: classic familial adenomatous polyposis
concepts.description: Familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) is characterized by the development of hundreds to thousands of adenomas in the rectum and colon during the second decade of life.
synonyms: familial adenomatous polyposis of the colon

concepts.label: familial adenomatous polyposis 1
concepts.description: An autosomal dominant disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the APC gene, characterized by the development of colorectal adenomatous polyposis, a very high risk of colorectal cancer and other extracolonic manifestations including both classic and attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP).

concepts.label: classic or attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis
concepts.description: An inherited diseases haracterized by the development of adenomas in the rectum and colon; classified into classic FAP and attenuated FAP.
synonyms: classic or attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis

concepts.label: neoplastic syndrome
concepts.description: A broad classification for disorders in which the development of neoplasms typically occur in association with a characteristic set of signs or symptoms. These disorders may be inherited or acquired.

concepts.label: RASopathy
concepts.description: Developmental syndromes caused by germline mutations (or in rare cases by somatic mosaicism) in genes that alter the Ras subfamily and mitogen-activated protein kinases that control signal transduction.

concepts.label: neurofibromatosis

concepts.label: malignant colon neoplasm
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the colon. Representative examples include carcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma.

concepts.label: jugulotympanic paraganglioma
concepts.description: A benign or malignant extra-adrenal parasympathetic paraganglioma arising from paraganglia in the base of the skull and middle ear.

concepts.label: pleural neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that involves the serous membrane that lines the lungs and thoracic cavity. Most pleural neoplasms are metastatic. Diffuse malignant mesothelioma is the most common primary malignant neoplasm of the pleura.

concepts.label: urinary system neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant, primary or metastatic neoplasm involving the urinary system. --2003

concepts.label: mediastinal germ cell tumor

concepts.label: hereditary neurological disease
concepts.description: A heterogeneous group of genetic conditions with Mendelian (autosomal dominant, recessive, or X-linked) or chromosomal etiology characterized by abnormalities in the brain, spinal cord, nerves, or muscles.

concepts.label: hereditary neuromuscular disease
concepts.description: A heterogeneous group of genetic conditions with Mendelian (autosomal dominant, recessive, or X-linked) or chromosomal etiology that is characterized by progressive muscle degeneration and weakness.

concepts.label: cardiogenetic disease
concepts.description: A heterogeneous group of genetic conditions, with Mendelian (autosomal dominant, recessive, or X-linked) or chromosomal etiology that are characterized by abnormalities in the cardiovascular system.

concepts.label: SERAC1-related neurological disorder
concepts.description: Any neurological disorder in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the SERAC1 gene.

concepts.label: orbital myositis

concepts.label: OPTN-related open angle glaucoma
concepts.description: Any open angle glaucoma in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the OPTN gene.

concepts.label: hereditary narcolepsy
concepts.description: An instance of narcolepsy that is caused by an inherited genomic modification in an individual.

concepts.label: PRRT2-associated paroxysmal movement disorder
concepts.description: A group of rare movement and seizure disorders caused by changes (disease-causing variants or mutations) in the PRRT2 gene. concepts.label: ALG14-congenital disorder of glycosylation
concepts.description: Deficiency in the ALG14 enzyme results in incomplete assembly of the lipid linked oligosaccharide (LLO), leading to insufficient N-glycosylation of glycoproteins.

concepts.label: ligneous conjunctivitis
concepts.description: A rare form of chronic conjunctivitis characterized by the development of firm fibrin-rich, woody-like pseudomembraneous lesions mainly on the tarsal conjunctivae. Ligneous conjunctivitis is usually the initial and most common manifestation of type I congenital plasminogen deficiency.

concepts.label: HBA1-related alpha thalassemia spectrum
concepts.description: Mild microcytic anemia caused by biallelic variation in the HBA1 gene.

concepts.label: HBA2-related alpha thalassemia spectrum
concepts.description: Mild microcytic anemia caused by biallelic variation in the HBA2 gene.

concepts.label: digenic alpha thalassemia spectrum
concepts.description: An instance of alpha thalessemia spectrum that is caused by an inherited multiallelic modification in an individual.

concepts.label: HBA1; HBA2-related digenic alpha thalassemia spectrum
concepts.description: Mild microcytic anemia caused by variation in two of the four copies of the alpha hemoglobin genes, which can be in cis (e.g., large deletion of HBA1 and HBA2 genes) or in trans (e.g., HBA1 variant on one chromosome and HBA2 variant on the other chromosome).

concepts.label: monogenic alpha thalassemia spectrum
concepts.description: An instance of alpha thalessemia spectrum that is caused by an inherited monogenomic modification in an individual.

concepts.description: A neonatal/infantile epilepsy syndrome that is characterized by the onset of myoclonic seizures between the ages of 6-18 months (range 4 months to 3 years). concepts.label: hereditary angioedema with normal C1Inh
concepts.description: A rare hereditary angioedema characterized by potentially life-threatening episodes of subcutaneous and/or submucosal edema without urticaria and with normal levels and function of C1 esterase inhibitor. concepts.label: ACD-related short telomere syndrome
concepts.description: A spectrum of conditions, including dyskeratosis congenita, Hoyeraal-Hreidarsson syndrome, hereditary aplastic anemia, and pulmonary fibrosis, typically characterized by shortened telomeres due to a pathogenic variant(s) in ACD that results in impaired telomere maintenance.

concepts.label: ACD-related long telomere syndrome
concepts.description: A telomere biology disorder typically characterized by increased telomere length due to a pathogenic variant in the ACD gene that may cause familial melanoma.

concepts.label: CTNNB1-related neurodevelopmental disorder and/or vitreoretinopathy
concepts.description: Any neurodevelopmental disorder and/or exudative vitreoretinopathy caused by a monoallelic variant in the CTNNB1 gene. concepts.label: MTOR-related overgrowth spectrum
concepts.description: Any overgrowth syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a pathogenic gain-of-function variants in the MTOR gene. The variants can be germline or somatic.

concepts.label: combined generalized and focal epilepsy
concepts.description: Any epilepsy where patients have both generalized and focal seizure types, with interictal and/or ictal EEG findings that accompany both seizure types. Patients with Dravet syndrome and Lennox-Gastaut syndrome may have combined focal and generalized epilepsy.

concepts.label: generalized epilepsy
concepts.description: Epilepsy that is characterized by generalized seizure types and may have typical interictal and/or ictal EEG findings that accompany generalized seizure types (for example generalized spike-wave).

concepts.label: genetic generalized epilepsy
concepts.description: A generalized epilepsy that is understood to have a genetic etiology. This does not always mean that the epilepsy is inherited or can be transmitted to offspring, as the genetic etiology may be a de novo pathogenic variant, or the genetic etiology may have complex/polygenic inheritance.

concepts.label: hereditary generalized epilepsy
concepts.description: An instance of generalized epilepsy that is caused by an inherited genomic modification in an individual.

concepts.label: myoclonic epilepsy
concepts.description: A group of epilepsy syndromes in which myoclonic seizures are a prominent feature.

concepts.label: ocular growth disorder
concepts.description: An eye disorder characterized by an aberrant development of the eye resulting in significant shortening or elongation, and therefore affecting the final ocular dimensions.

concepts.label: TOR1AIP1-related myopathy
concepts.description: A congenital myopathy in which the cause of the disease is pathogenic variation in the TOR1AIP1 gene. May include fatigable muscle weakness resulting from impaired transmission at the neuromuscular synapse.

concepts.description: Any Ehlers-Danlos syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a variant in the COL1A1 gene. This includes classic and arthrochalasia types as well as combined osteogenesis imperfecta and Ehlers-Danlos syndrome.

concepts.label: COL1A2-related Ehlers-Danlos syndrome
concepts.description: Any Ehler-Danlos syndrome caused by any variant in the COL1A2 gene.

concepts.label: ciliary dyskinesia, primary, 54

concepts.label: ALPL-related autosomal dominant hypophosphatasia
concepts.description: Any hypophosphatasia in which the cause of the disease is a variant with a dominant negative effect or haploinsufficiency in the ALPL gene.

concepts.description: Any hypophosphatasia in which the cause of the disease is an autosomal recessive loss-of-function in the ALPL gene.

concepts.description: The mildest form of autism spectrum disorder, characterized by difficulties with social communication and restricted, repetitive behaviors, requiring minimal support for daily functioning.

concepts.label: autism spectrum disorder 2
concepts.description: A moderate form of autism spectrum disorder marked by more significant challenges in social communication and more noticeable restricted, repetitive behaviors, requiring substantial support for daily functioning.

concepts.label: autism spectrum disorder 3
concepts.description: The most severe form of autism spectrum disorder, characterized by severe impairments in social communication and extreme restricted, repetitive behaviors, requiring very substantial support for daily functioning.

concepts.label: BMP4-related ocular growth disorder
concepts.description: Any ocular growth disorder in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the BMP4 gene.

concepts.label: syndromic congenital heart disease
concepts.description: Congenital heart disease with co-occurrence of other extracardiac congenital anomalies, or well characterized genetic conditions.

concepts.description: Any neurological disorder in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the VPS11 gene.

concepts.label: variable age epilepsy syndrome
concepts.description: An epilepsy syndrome that has an onset during variable ages and stages of life.

concepts.description: An epilepsy associated with developmental impairment that may be due to either the underlying etiology or the superimposed epileptic activity, or both.

concepts.label: acquired developmental and epileptic encephalopathy
concepts.description: An instance of developmental and epileptic encephalopathy that is acquired during the lifetime of the individual.

concepts.label: DCTN1-related neurodegeneration

concepts.label: SAMD9-related spectrum and myeloid neoplasm risk

concepts.label: KIF5A-related neurological disorder

concepts.label: radiation-induced neuropathy

concepts.label: endocrine myopathy

concepts.label: uterine ligament adenosarcoma
concepts.description: An extremely rare adenosarcoma that arises from the uterine ligament.

concepts.description: A congenital disorder of glycosylation with a SSR3 deficiency that affects the brain, lungs and gastrointestinal system, and presents with clinical phenotypes such as seizures, intellectual disability, developmental delay, microcephaly and abnormal brain structure.

concepts.label: phrynoderma
concepts.description: Phrynoderma is a form of follicular hyperkeratosis seen in young children and adolescents due to nutritional deficiencies. It is clinically characterized by discrete, follicular, skin-colored papules with keratotic plugs distributed over elbows, knees, extensor extremities, and buttocks.

concepts.label: episodic angioedema with eosinophilia
concepts.description: A disorder characterized by episodes of swelling under the skin (angioedema) and an elevated number of the white blood cells known as eosinophils (eosinophilia). concepts.label: SEC61B-related polycystic liver disease

concepts.label: glutaminase deficiency
concepts.description: Glutaminase deficiency is characterized by refractory seizures, respiratory failure, brain abnormalities and death in the neonatal period, though milder cases with spastic ataxia-dysarthria have also been reported. This condition is caused by mutations in the glutaminase (GLS) gene.

concepts.label: hemorrhagic fever
concepts.description: An infectious disease caused by certain viruses or bacteria that can damage the walls of tiny blood vessels, making them leak, and can hamper the blood's ability to clot and cause severe, life-threatening illness.

concepts.label: bacterial hemorrhagic fever
concepts.description: A hemorrhagic fever caused by bacteria. Bacterial hemorrhagic disease is rare. One example of a bacterial hemorrhagic disease is scrub typhus.

concepts.label: severe hypophosphatasia
concepts.description: A rare, severe form of hypophosphatasia characterized by infantile rickets without elevated serum alkaline phosphatase (ALP) activity and a wide range of clinical manifestations due to hypomineralization. concepts.label: moderate hypophosphatasia
concepts.description: A rare, moderate form of hypophosphatasia characterized by defective mineralization of bone and/or teeth, premature loss of teeth with intact roots, and reduced serum alkaline phosphatase (ALP) activity. concepts.label: alveolar capillary dysplasia without misalignment of pulmonary veins
concepts.description: A rare form of interstitial and vascular lung disease that presents as severe pulmonary hypertension and refractory hypoxemia early in life that is characterized by a lack of misalignment of the pulmonary veins.

concepts.label: acinar dysplasia
concepts.description: A lethal, developmental lung malformation resulting in neonatal respiratory insufficiency. It is characterized by pulmonary hypoplasia and arrest in the pseudoglandular stage of development, resulting in the absence of functional gas exchange. It can be caused by mutations in FGF10, FGFR2 or TBX4.

concepts.label: acinar dysplasia caused by mutation in FGF10
concepts.description: Any acinar dysplasia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the FGF10 gene.

concepts.label: acinar dysplasia caused by mutation in FGFR2
concepts.description: Any acinar dysplasia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the FGFR2 gene.

concepts.label: acinar dysplasia caused by mutation in TBX4
concepts.description: Any acinar dysplasia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the TBX4 gene.

concepts.label: idiopathic inflammatory myopathy
concepts.description: Idiopathic form of inflammatory myopathy.

concepts.label: familial idiopathic inflammatory myopathy
concepts.description: An instance of myositis that is caused by an inherited genomic modification in an individual, and has an unknown cause.

concepts.label: congenital right-sided heart lesions
concepts.description: Serious heritable structural anomalies of the right side of the heart, including pulmonary atresia, tricuspid valve disease and Ebstein's anomaly, and right ventricular outflow tract obstruction and/or pulmonary stenosis, that are present from birth.

concepts.label: B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia with t(1;19)(q23;p13.3); E2A-PBX1 (TCF3-PBX1)

concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the KMT2A gene at 11q23.3 and another gene partner resulting in the production of a KMT2A related fusion protein.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with ETV6-RUNX1
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the TEL gene on chromosome 12 and the AML1 gene on chromosome 21, (p13.2;q22.1). It results in the production of the TEL-AML1 (ETV6-RUNX1) fusion protein.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with IL3-IGH
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the IL3 gene on chromosome 5 and the IGH locus on chromosome 14, (q31.1;q32.3).

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, BCR-ABL1–like
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that has a gene expression profile similar to that of B-ALL with t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2) BCR-ABL1, but lacks that gene fusion.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with IAMP21
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by amplification of a portion of chromosome 21.

concepts.label: spinal muscular atrophy type 0
concepts.description: A childhood spinal muscular atrophy that is evident before birth and characterized by diminished movement in the womb, joint deformities, extremely weak muscle tone and very weak respiratory muscles.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma WNT activated
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the WNT pathway and TP53 mutations may be present or absent.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma SHH activated
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and TP53 mutations that may be present or absent.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma that is characterized as a molecular subtype that is not associated with activation of the WNT pathway or sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and TP53 mutations are absent.

concepts.label: NK cell deficiency
concepts.description: A primary immunodeficiency disease that results from defeciency in the number or function of CD56+CD3− NK cell in peripheral blood.

concepts.label: T cell and NK cell immunodeficiency
concepts.description: A primary immunodeficiency disease that involves multiple components of the immune system, including both T cell and NK cell immunodeficiency.

concepts.label: autoimmune cholangitis
concepts.description: An autoimmune hepatitis that is characterized by primary biliary cirrhosis clinical, biochemical, and histologic characteristics with antinuclear antibody positive sera.

concepts.label: mucinous pancreas adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A pancreatic adenocarcinoma that derives from epithelial cells originating in glandular tissue, which produce mucin.

concepts.label: childhood acute megakaryoblastic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute megakaryocytic leukemia that is characterized by fusion oncogenes involving transcriptional regulators in childhood.

concepts.label: core binding factor acute myeloid leukemia
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by the presence of t(8;21)(q22;q22) or inv(16)(p13q22)/t(16;16)(p13;q22). These cytogenetic abnormalities result in disruption of the transcription factor CBF, which is a regulator of normal hematopoiesis.

concepts.label: myeloid leukemia associated with down syndrome
concepts.description: An acute megakaryocytic leukemia occurring in children with Down syndrome and that has material basis in mutation in the GATA1 gene.

concepts.label: salivary gland mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A salivary gland carcinoma that is characterized by the presence of large pools of extracellular mucin in which clusters of malignant epithelial cells are found.

concepts.label: mammary analog secretory carcinoma
concepts.description: A salivary gland carcinoma that has material basis in a chromosomal translocation that results in an ETV6-NTRK3 fusion gene.

concepts.label: pemphigoid
concepts.description: An autoimmune disease of skin and connective tissue that is characterized by subepidermal blistering especially in the lower abdomen, groin, and flexor surfaces of the extremities, creating tense blisters that do not break easily.

concepts.label: intracranial meningioma
concepts.description: A meningioma that arises within the cranial cavity.

concepts.label: supratentorial meningioma
concepts.description: A meningioma that affects the supratentorial brain.

concepts.label: anaplastic pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma
concepts.description: A malignant astrocytoma that is characterized by the presence of five or more mitoses per 10 high-power fields.

concepts.label: IDH-mutant anaplastic astrocytoma
concepts.description: An anaplastic astrocytoma carrying IDH mutations.

concepts.label: IDH-wildtype anaplastic astrocytoma
concepts.description: An anaplastic astrocytoma lacking mutations in IDH1 or IDH2 genes.

concepts.label: IDH-wildtype glioblastoma
concepts.description: A glioblastoma that is characterized by high cellularity, high mitotic activity, necrosis or microvascular proliferation and that lacks mutations in IDH genes.

concepts.label: spinal ependymoma, MYCN-amplified
concepts.description: A spinal cord ependymoma that is characterized by MYCN amplification.

concepts.label: posterior fossa ependymoma
concepts.description: A high grade ependymoma that is located within the posterior fossa.

concepts.label: supratentorial ependymoma
concepts.description: A high grade ependymoma that is located within the supratentorial brain.

concepts.label: oral rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A rhabdomyosarcoma located in the oral cavity.

concepts.label: bladder sarcomatoid transitional cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A sarcomatoid transitional cell carcinoma that is located in the bladder.

concepts.label: astroblastoma, MN1-altered
concepts.description: An astroblastoma that is characterized by astroblastoma-like morphology with MN1 rearrangements involving the meningioma 1 (MN1) gene on chromosome 22q.

concepts.label: immunoglobulin heavy-and-light chain
concepts.description: An amyloidosis that is characterized by both Ig heavy chains and LC contribute to the amyloid fibrils.

concepts.label: childhood supratentorial embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered
concepts.description: A childhood embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered that arises from the supratentorial brain and occurs in children.

concepts.label: rhabdomyolysis-myalgia syndrome
concepts.description: A myopathy that is characterized by muscle breakdown (rhabdomyolysis), heat and exertion-related muscle pain (myalgia) and cramping symptoms, severe muscle pain, sudden elevation and subsequent fall of serum creatine phosphokinase levels and products of muscle breakdown in the urine (myoglobinuri...

concepts.label: tuberculous encephalopathy
concepts.description: A tuberculosis that is characterized by cerebral edema sometimes with features similar to acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (ADEM) and may manifest with a variety of symptoms ranging from focal neurological deficits to convulsions and decreased conscious state.

concepts.label: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma activated B-cell type
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by the expression of CD44, PKCbeta1, Cyclin D2, BCL-2, and IRF4/MUM1 genes.

concepts.label: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma germinal center B-cell type
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by the expression of CD10, BCL-6, A-myb, and LMO2 genes, BCL-2 translocation, and c-REL amplification.

concepts.label: high-grade B-cell lymphoma double-hit/triple-hit
concepts.description: A B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by the abnormal rearrangement of two genes, MYC gene and either BCL2 or BCL6 genes.

concepts.label: mixed phenotype acute leukemia with BCR-ABL1
concepts.description: An acute biphenotypic leukemia that is characterized by blasts that also carry the translocation t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2) by karyotypic analysis or the BCR-ABL1 translocation by FISH or PCR.

concepts.label: mixed phenotype acute leukemia with MLL rearranged
concepts.description: An acute biphenotypic leukemia that is characterized by blasts which carry a translocation between the MLL (KMT2A) gene at 11q23.3 and another gene partner.

concepts.label: mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid
concepts.description: An acute biphenotypic leukemia that is characterized by blasts which express B-lymphoid and myeloid lineage markers but are negative for MLL translocation and t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) translocation.

concepts.label: mixed phenotype acute leukemia,T/myeloid
concepts.description: An acute biphenotypic leukemia that is characterized by blasts that express antigens of both T and myeloid antigens.

concepts.label: primary cutaneous gamma-delta t-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A primary cutaneous T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma that is characterized by the clonal cutaneous proliferation of activated mature gamma-delta T cells with a cytotoxic phenotype.

concepts.label: neurobehavioral disorder with prenatal alcohol exposure
concepts.description: A fetal alcohol spectrum disorder that is characterized by one or more deficits in neurocognition and in self-regulation plus two or more deficits in adaptive functioning, with at least 1 in communication or social communication and interaction.

concepts.label: BN2 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as BN2 with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. concepts.label: EZB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as EZB with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features and EZB DLBCLs often, but do not always, have hot spot mutations in EZH2 and/or a BCL2 translocation. This class can be further subdivided...

concepts.label: MCD diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as MCD with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features and MCD DLBCLs often, but do not always, have the most common hot spot mutation in MYD88 (L265P) and/or activating mutations in CD79B. Thi...

concepts.label: N1 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as N1 with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features. concepts.label: ST2 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as ST2 with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features and ST2 DLBCLs often, but do not always, have missense or nonsense mutations affecting TET2 and NFKBIA. This subgroup also commonly has mu...

concepts.label: A53 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by aneuploidy with TP53 inactivation.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia, t(8;21)(q22; q22.1)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia associated with t(8;21)(q22;q22) resulting in RUNX1-RUNX1T1 fusion protein expression. The bone marrow and the peripheral blood show large myeloblasts with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, often containing azurophilic granules.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia, t(1;22)(p13;q13)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia typically showing megakaryocytic maturation and associated with t(1;22)(p13;q13), resulting in the expression of RBM15-MKL1 fusion protein.

concepts.label: injection anthrax
concepts.description: An anthrax disease that is characterized by infection at the injection site or deep under the skin or in the muscle where the drug was injected and is caused by heroin contaminated with anthrax spores.

concepts.label: dendritic cell deficiency
concepts.description: A primary immunodeficiency disease characterized by impaired function or reduced numbers of dendritic cells.

concepts.label: pituitary blastoma
concepts.description: A pituitary cancer that is characterized by features of Cushing disease, with elevated blood ACTH levels and hypercortisolism arising within the fetal anterior pituitary and associated with DICER1 mutations.

concepts.label: diffuse pediatric-type high-grade glioma, H3-wildtype and IDH-wildtype
concepts.description: A high grade glioma that is characterized by the absence of histone H3, IDH1, and IDH2 mutations.

concepts.label: infant-type hemispheric glioma
concepts.description: A malignant astrocytoma that is characterized by receptor tyrosine kinase fusions in the NTRK family, ROS1, ALK, or MET genes, that arises in the cerebral hemisphere and occurs in early childhood.

concepts.label: high-grade astrocytoma with piloid features
concepts.description: An anaplastic astrocytoma that is characterized by high-grade piloid and/or glioblastoma-like histological features. It may occur anywhere in the central nervous system but most often arises in the posterior fossa.

concepts.label: spindle cell oncocytoma
concepts.description: A posterior pituitary benign neoplasm that is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm forming fascicles.

concepts.label: central nervous system tumor with bcor internal tandem duplication
concepts.description: A central nervous system embryonal tumor that is characterized by the presence of uniform oval or spindle-shaped cells with round or oval nuclei, pseudorosette formation, and heterozygous internal tandem duplication in exon 15 of the BCOR gene.

concepts.label: primary intracranial sarcoma, DICER1-mutant
concepts.description: A brain sarcoma that is composed of malignant pleomorphic or spindle neoplastic cells typically demonstrating myogenic and/or chondroid differentiation. Cytoplasmic eosinophilic globules and myxoid stroma formation are usually present. It is associated with mutations in the DICER1 gene.

concepts.description: A low grade glioma that is characterized by a gene alteration that results in a MAPK pathway abnormality, with morphological features of astrocytoma or oligodendroglioma.

concepts.label: diffuse astrocytoma, MYB- or MYBL1-altered
concepts.description: A diffuse astrocytoma that is a diffusely infiltrative astroglial neoplasm composed of monomorphic cells with genetic alterations in MYB or MYBL1.

concepts.label: grade I lymphomatoid granulomatosis
concepts.description: A lymphomatoid granulomatosis that is characterized by the presence of a polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate without cytologic atypia. Large lymphocytes are absent or rare. By in situ hybridization, EBV-positive cells are infrequently seen.

concepts.label: grade II lymphomatoid granulomatosis
concepts.description: A lymphomatoid granulomatosis that is characterized by the presence of occasional large lymphoid cells or immunoblasts in a polymorphous background. Necrosis is more commonly seen as compared to grade I lymphomatoid granulomatosis. By in situ hybridization, EBV-positive cells are readily seen.

concepts.label: grade III lymphomatoid granulomatosis
concepts.description: A lymphomatoid granulomatosis that is characterized by the presence of aggregates of neoplastic large B-lymphocytes, usually admixed with pleomorphic and Hodgkin-like cells, in a background of chronic inflammation. Necrotic changes are present and are usually extensive.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma SHH activated and TP53 wild-type
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma SHH activated that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and the absence of TP53 mutations.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH group 3
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH that is characterized as a molecular subtype by absent TP53 mutations and MYC amplifications that may be present.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH group 4
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH that is characterized as a molecular subtype by the absence of MYC amplifications and TP53 mutations, while chromosome 17 abnormalities may be present.

concepts.label: astrocytoma, IDH-mutant, grade 4
concepts.description: An IDH-mutant anaplastic astrocytoma that is characterized by the presence of necrosis and/or microvascular proliferation or homozygous deletion of CDKN2A and/or CDKN2B genes. The term glioblastoma no longer applies to central nervous system WHO grade 4 IDH-mutant astrocytomas.

concepts.label: pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma BRAF mutant
concepts.description: An anaplastic pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma that has material basis in BRAF mutations.

concepts.label: YAP1-MAMLD1 fusion-positive supratentorial ependymoma
concepts.description: A supratentorial ependymoma that has material basis in YAP1-MAMLD1 fusion.

concepts.label: EZB-MYC+ diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: An EZB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that expresses the double hit gene expression signature (DHITsig+) according to gene expression profiling. In addition to the features characteristic of EZB, these cases commonly, but do not always, harbour MYC translocations and DDX3X mutations.

concepts.label: EZB-MYC- diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: An EZB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that does not express the double hit gene expression signature (DHITsig-) according to gene expression profiling. These cases tend to have few MYC translocations or DDX3X mutations.

concepts.label: supratentorial ependymoma, ZFTA fusion–positive
concepts.description: A suptratentorial ependymoma that is characterized by the presence of a fusion gene involving ZFTA gene.

concepts.label: supratentorial ependymoma, YAP1 fusion–positive
concepts.description: A supratentorial ependymoma that is characterized by the presence of a fusion gene involving YAP1 gene.

concepts.label: posterior fossa group A ependymoma
concepts.description: A posterior fossa ependymoma that arises in the posterior fossa with characteristic DNA methylation patterns, including CpG island hypermethylation, global DNA hypomethylation, reduction of nuclear H3 p.K28me3 (K27me3) expression, and EZHIP overexpression.

concepts.label: posterior fossa group B ependymoma
concepts.description: A posterior fossa ependymoma that arises in the posterior fossa with characteristic DNA methylation patterns including retention of nuclear H3 p.K28me3 (K27me3) expression, absence of CpG island hypermethylation, absence of global DNA hypomethylation, and absence of EZHIP overexpression.

concepts.label: astrocytoma, IDH-mutant, grade 2

concepts.label: astrocytoma, IDH-mutant, grade 3

concepts.description: A form of hyperthyroidism caused by overproduction of thyroid hormones (T3 and T4) due to pathology within the thyroid gland itself. Primary hyperthyroidism is characterized by low TSH levels and elevated T3/T4 levels.

concepts.label: secondary hyperthyroidism
